title: Locally closed support adjunction and ambient internal Hom
statement: Let l be prime, k a field of positive characteristic p different from l, X separated of finite type over k, Λ admissible [sk-def-localizing-closure], and L in Dctf(X,Λ) [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let j:S→Z be open, i:Z→X closed and a=j≫i. Put F=D(j_!)≫Ri_* on the ordinary ambient derived module categories. F maps Loc(Dctf(S,Λ)) into Loc(Dctf(X,Λ)), and the resulting restricted functor has a right adjoint G. There is an object N of the latter full subcategory whose underlying object is L, with G(N) in Dctf(S,Λ). For every ambient P on S, RHom_X(F(P),L) is isomorphic to Ra_*RHom_S(P,G(N)), for the specified ambient internal Hom and direct images. The formula is internal sheaf-valued Hom, not only global Hom.

source.place: Steps 8--10; support fiber, adjunction and first displayed isomorphism

proof.text: Let $a:S\hookrightarrow X$ be as in the statement. Use its given factorization $S\xrightarrow{u}Z\xrightarrow{i}X$ with $u$ open and $i$ closed, and let $j:X\setminus Z\hookrightarrow X$ be the complementary open. Put $T=u^*R\underline\Gamma_ZL$, using the ambient derived support adjoint of [det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction]. Its fiber formula is $R\underline\Gamma_ZL\simeq i^*\operatorname{fib}(L\to Rj_*j^*L)$. Each of $j^*$, $Rj_*$ and $i^*$ preserves $\Dctf$ by [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images](1),(3). Step 2 therefore puts this fiber and then $R\underline\Gamma_ZL$ in $\Dctf$, and the same node's pullback clause puts $T$ in $\Dctf(S,\Lambda)$. This establishes support preservation without inferring it from existence of a right adjoint.

source.place: Paragraphs 2 and 3, locally closed support and preservation, with the ambient support object made explicit.

proof.text: The closed immersion $i$ is proper by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper](a), so $(u,i)$ is a compactification of $a$. It computes $Ra_!=Ri_*u_!=i_*u_!=a_!$, because $i_*$ and $u_!$ are exact [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed, lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor]; this is the compactification formula of [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek]. Its comparison with the chosen compactification on the localizing closure is [det-sf-comp-coherence-cocycle]. For any $B\in\Loc(\Dctf(S,\Lambda))$, the ambient adjunction $i_*\dashv R\underline\Gamma_Z$ [det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction], followed by the ambient derived open adjunction $u_!\dashv u^*$ [def-sfb-dc-open-lower-shriek-adjunction], gives $\Hom_X(a_!B,L)\cong\Hom_S(B,T)$. By [sk-prop-sf-existence], the same functor is represented by $a^!L$. Both representing objects lie in the full localizing closure: $T$ by Step 8, and $a^!L$ by its definition. Transpose each counit under the other adjunction; the two resulting maps $T\rightleftarrows a^!L$ compose to the identities by the adjunction triangle identities. Thus $T\simeq a^!L$, naturally in $L$. This comparison tests only objects of the localizing closure, where that adjunction is actually defined.

source.place: Paragraph 2, trivial compactification and adjunction, repairing the scope of the Yoneda argument.

proof.text:
Now apply the ambient internal-Hom formulas of [lem-sfb-open-closed-internal-hom-formulas], first to $i$ and then to $u$ with target $R\underline\Gamma_ZL$. They give
$$\cHom_X(i_*u_!P,L)\simeq i_*\cHom_Z(u_!P,R\underline\Gamma_ZL)\simeq i_*Ru_*\cHom_S(P,u^*R\underline\Gamma_ZL).$$
The ringed-topos composition comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition], with exact $i_*$, identifies $i_*Ru_*=Ra_*$. Step 9 replaces $u^*R\underline\Gamma_ZL$ by $a^!L$. We obtain the first stated isomorphism in the entire ambient $D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$, naturally in $P,L$. Unlike a calculation of global Hom alone, the cited formulas are identities of internal sheaf-valued derived Hom, without constructibility assumptions.

source.place: Paragraph 2, first internal-Hom isomorphism, using ambient open/closed internal adjunction.

proof.text:
For the closed immersion i choose the complementary open v. The ambient closed
support right adjoint RΓ_Z has the fiber formula i^*fib(L -> Rv_*v^*L). Pullback and
direct-image stability and triangulated closure therefore put this object in Dctf.
Compose RΓ_Z with j^* to obtain T. The ambient adjunctions i_* ⊣ RΓ_Z and j_! ⊣ j^*
compose to an ambient adjunction for F=i_*j_!. The compactification formula and
coproduct preservation show that F preserves the localizing closures. Brown
representability gives the restricted right adjoint G. Take N to be L with the
localizing membership induced by its Dctf membership. The object T also lies in the
full localizing closure, by its Dctf membership. For every object B of that closure,
the ambient adjunction and the restricted adjunction identify Hom(B,T) and
Hom(B,G(N)). Transposing their counits gives inverse maps by the triangle identities,
so G(N) is isomorphic to T and lies in Dctf. This comparison requires no assertion
that the ambient support functor preserves the entire localizing closure.
The ambient closed and open internal-Hom isomorphisms give successively
Hom_X(i_*j_!P,L) = i_*Hom_Z(j_!P,RΓ_Z L)
= i_*Rj_*Hom_S(P,j^*RΓ_Z L). The derived pushforward composition comparison and the
exactness of closed direct image identify the last object with Ra_*Hom_S(P,G(N)).
The equality a=j≫i identifies the maps. These are identities in the full ambient
derived categories, not merely identities of global Hom or tests on the localizing
closure. Empty strata give the zero adjoint and zero formula; the identity immersion
gives the identity adjunction and formula.

theorem locallyClosed_support_hom_model
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ)
    (L : (DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))))
    (hL : constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X L ∧ DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ L)
    (S Z : Scheme.{u}) (a : S ⟶ X) (j : S ⟶ Z) (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsClosedImmersion i] (ha : a = j ≫ i) :
    let F := (openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
      (lowerStar Λ i).rightDerivedFunctor
    ∃ (h : ∀ M, localizingClosureProEtale Λ S M →
        localizingClosureProEtale Λ X (F.obj M))
      (G : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory ⥤
        (localizingClosureProEtale Λ S).FullSubcategory),
      Nonempty ((localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).lift
        ((localizingClosureProEtale Λ S).ι ⋙ F) (fun M ↦ h M.obj M.property) ⊣ G) ∧
      ∃ N : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory, N.obj = L ∧
        (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ S (G.obj N).obj ∧
          DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ (G.obj N).obj) ∧
        ∀ P : (DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ S))),
      Nonempty (((derivedHom Λ X).obj (op (F.obj P))).obj L ≅
          (lowerStar Λ a).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
            (((derivedHom Λ S).obj (op P)).obj (G.obj N).obj))
